notes.subject: מלאת דין
notes.rationale: 'You have filled the judgment of the wicked' vs 'you are full of the wicked's judgment' vs 'your lawsuit is like the wicked's' — KJV, JPS and Wycliffe divide sharply

notes.subject: יתמכו
notes.rationale: 'they will uphold you/it' — subject unclear: judgment and justice seize you (KJV) or are themselves upheld (YL T), or take hold of them, the wicked (JPS)

translation: Nka i ye jurumutɔw ka dantigɛ tigɛ; dantigɛ ni sariya bɛ i mara.
